name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.231.0 — One port per launch (20261005/03): smoke.sh gives every run of a host whose readyCheck reads $PORT its own free loopback port and exports it as PORT; prototype.url may carry {port}, and the prototype and build drivers keep one port per prototype/build, print PORT=<n> <bootCommand>, and probe and capture at the resolved address; a saved single-origin sign-in is re-pointed to the capture port; /spec:doctor check 19 (Fixed ports) flags loopback fixed ports in the config. Fixed-address hosts are unchanged. Grounding contract changed — hosts owe a /spec:doctor re-stamp. 7.230.0 — Connect runs first (specs/20261005/02): /spec:connect works in a project with no config — it creates .claude/spec.config.json holding only the walkthrough block after the link is proved, refuses a present-but-unusable config as bad-config, names git init first in a folder that is not a git repository, and prints next: /spec:genesis in an empty ungrounded folder. init-gen generate carries the walkthrough block from disk with and without --refresh and treats a block-only config as not yet generated; the state gate warns of grounding drift only for a config carrying generatedBy. 7.229.0 — /spec:connect wires a client project to the hosted review service in one command: it creates or joins the project via Railway, stores the token in the git-ignored settings.local.json, proves the link, and writes the walkthrough block. The client now reads the stored token before the environment variable, and the mocks driver's terminal-confirm step names /spec:connect. The grounding contract's tokenEnv clause changed, so hosts owe a /spec:doctor re-stamp.
